title: A2A Agent Card Signing Ceremony
scope: RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization with protobuf field-presence rules
JWS signatures using published federation JWKS
Dual-signing / rollback overlap where technically possible
Independent verification before and after deploy
No new external peer receives trust or execution authority
ceremony_steps: 1. Generate signing key in protected HSM/KMS
2. Assign immutable kid, algorithm, activation, expiration
3. Publish public key through federation JWKS
4. Implement canonicalization from protobuf-aware card model
9. Have AAA + separate verifier validate all cards
11. Retire old key only after overlap window
